responsibility: This machine-description fragment defines the H8/300 family RTL expanders and instruction patterns for integer addition, subtraction, and negation across QI/HI/SI modes, including H8SX-specific short-immediate forms and split patterns that add condition-code clobbers after reload. It owns how generic GCC plus/minus/neg RTL is matched to H8 add/sub/inc/dec/adds/subs/neg instructions, when constants are decomposed via split_adds_subs or emitted through output_plussi and compute_plussi_length, and how result-setting versus CC-setting variants are exposed for compare elimination and later scheduling.
